additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397365-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000697] OCPP Offline CRM:01811000539
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000697
Charger ID/Serial No.:
TmguWp
Problem Description:
OCPP Offline
The customer reported that after an auto reboot, the charger went offline on OCPP, and they are unable to access the router on SCB. This is not the first time this issue has occurred, and it seems there may be a problem with both the OCPP and SCB routers.
Please plan a site intervention to analyze the problems with both routers. Additionally, we observed the error SCB
PaymentTerminalUnreachable. Kindly follow the Knowledge Article for this issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Payment_ ErrorFlag _PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx - Dynamics 365
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since9/8/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
